description:
Cast Sylvan Offering by paying {5}{G}, causing you and an opponent to create a 5/5 Treefolk creature token and five 1/1 Elf Warrior creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Treefolk token, untapping a basic Mountain you control.
Activate the Mountain by tapping it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2 five additional times, tapping the Elf Warrior tokens instead.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and giving you an extra combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.
